mis_54aa6238609d4cf4b64123d07f02845e.goal: Develop physical designs with the best available methods

obs_26ac21483a8943bba1a79c603c6df4eb.summary:
Receiver-owned capability-development need: Develop rough-transport cart designs with a method another lab published. Adopting or running the method requires a role holding method.develop
Desired acceptance: Beats the fixed cart by one success on twelve fresh public instances
An exact network method selection is retained as evidence (f99f5dc340ad4ec100f2d85c720a7fd42ad4a7b918eb8be127f2e2c18ac85ce5). It is not an installed Actor capability or an accepted method. Assess continuing responsibility using the existing owners; create a specialist only when distinct continuing work justifies it. Availability alone requires no organizational change.

req_4da6556b15fd4be882ceeced46387687.acceptance: On twelve fresh public instances, the developed cart design succeeds on at least one more instance than the fixed cart baseline.
req_4da6556b15fd4be882ceeced46387687.summary: Develop rough-transport cart designs by adopting and running the externally published method, with the retained method selection as the starting evidence.

rsp_8e5da6433d9d43e2ac0a7fda353af0d3.purpose: Adopt and run the published method to develop rough-transport cart designs that beat the fixed cart baseline.
rsp_8e5da6433d9d43e2ac0a7fda353af0d3.termination: A developed cart design beats the fixed cart by at least one success on twelve fresh public instances, or the method is judged unsuitable and the result is recorded.
rsp_8e5da6433d9d43e2ac0a7fda353af0d3.trigger: Method-development need recorded in observation obs_26ac21483a8943bba1a79c603c6df4eb.
